name: Tian Zhao
source:
The free-spirited, mischievous, and reckless dragon who saved Chi An when she fell from the bridge during the Dragon Festival. Tian Zhao is now the only color Chi An can see through her eyes. Ten years later, he came to the Human’s Realm to fulfill his promise of meeting Chi An again.

A lover of rice wine, and a hater of radish.
Interests: Humans & Adventures
